name: Peter Staber
headline: Head of Project Delivery at Australian Payments Network (AusPayNet)
about:
Combining a strong technical background with a big picture viewpoint has been vital in achieving the progression I have to date; this intuitive ability to understand the detail without losing site of all the pieces that need to be slotted together is not only my strength, it’s what I enjoy. 

Essential to program leadership, I’ve consistently demonstrated success in highly complex, technical multi-project and multi-vendor project delivery and have gained invaluable experience leading teams of up to 50 to deliver 130-project programs that achieve stretching business objectives in a highly competitive and cost conscious environment. Refining my skills in people leadership and stakeholder engagement quickly, I’m recognised as being an SME in my field, a high-level strategic thinker and “go-to” when results need to be delivered, on time and to the highest of quality standards.

I’m resilient in the face of adversity, and over 10 years’ experience in corporate project management has taught me one thing: having a strong team that works effectively is the key to everyone’s success. A number one priority in day-to-day operations and when scoping the next big program, I’m experienced in annual planning, resource management and recruitment, leading through consensus and collaboration to build motivated, engaged and high-performing teams.

Interested in connecting to discuss senior PMO, Program or Project Director roles, I welcome all invitations to connect, and am keen to develop wider networks within the business community. Should you wish to get in contact, please drop me an email, or connect through LinkedIn.
